books.title: The Midnight Library
books.author: Matt Haig
books.description: Between life and death there is a library, and within that library, the shelves go on forever. While there, Nora Seed must decide what is really fulfilling in life, and what makes it worth living at all.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving every day. James Clear reveals practical strategies that will teach you exactly how to form good habits, break bad ones, and master the tiny behaviors that lead to remarkable results.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, who would become the mysterious man known as Muad'Dib. He would avenge the traitorous plot against his noble family and bring to fruition humankind's most ancient and unattainable dream.

books.title: Becoming
books.author: Michelle Obama
books.description: In her memoir, Michelle Obama invites readers into her world, chronicling the experiences that have shaped her — from her childhood on the South Side of Chicago to her years as an executive, a mom, and as First Lady of the United States.

books.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
books.author: Delia Owens
books.description: For years, rumors of the 'Marsh Girl' have haunted Barkley Cove, a quiet town on the North Carolina coast. Kya Clark is described as a wild thing who has raised herself alone in the marsh. When the popular young man Chase Andrews is found dead, the locals blame Kya.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission — and if he fails, humanity and the Earth itself will perish. Except that right now, he doesn't know that. He can't even remember his own name, let alone the nature of his assignment or how to complete it.

books.title: The Vanishing Half
books.author: Brit Bennett
books.description: The Vignes twin sisters will always be identical. But after growing up together in a small, southern Black community and running away at age sixteen, it's not just the shape of their daily lives that is different as adults, it's everything.

books.title: Educated
books.author: Tara Westover
books.description: Tara Westover was seventeen the first time she set foot in a classroom. Born to survivalists in the mountains of Idaho, she prepared for the end of the world by stockpiling food and canning peaches. In the absence of schooling, she began to educate herself.
